label: POC Onboarding: Tag Mapping
mcp_tool_description: List, add or remove a resource handler's tag mappings: lines of attribute=TagName where attribute is group, owner, os_family, environment, hostname, os_build or any parameter shown on servers (create one with onb_parameter, show_on_servers true). The same lines on two handlers give consistent tags across clouds (test plan 1.2.2); cost_center=CostCenter with a group parameter gives 2.5.1. onb_tag_action list only reports. Requires a CloudBolt admin caller.
